ero.name: apartigilo
ero.description: A divider: a line that separates groups of content where space alone does not. Horizontal or vertical; a separator for assistive technology, or nothing at all where it only decorates.

props.name: orientation
props.description: horizontal draws the line across its container between groups that stand above each other; vertical draws it along the block axis between groups that stand side by side.

props.name: decorative
props.description: The line only decorates: nothing for assistive technology (role none). Default false: a separator between groups of content.
